Keyboard Tester Help

Keyboard Tester Diagnostics Instructions:

  • Press physical keys to test the layout.
  • Pressed keys light up based on their grid position.
  • 'Tested' keys remain highlighted in their respective color.
  • Latency Delta displays your browser event processing latency.
  • Click 'Pass Test' or 'Fail Test' to record the result and return.
